reason: Both correctly refused the DIY regas up front, but Conversation 1 reached the right conclusion (sealed-system fault, refrigeration engineer) in three turns once the no-frost, non-stop compressor and lukewarm condenser evidence was in. Conversation 2 wrongly declared 'the cooling circuit itself is likely working fine', chased blocked-duct and damper theories, asked for a pointless 24-hour defrost despite zero frost, and even reinterpreted the knife-defrosting admission as a cracked air duct rather than a probable evaporator puncture. Neither raised the uneconomic-repair/replacement point or explained the R600a flammability risk, but Conversation 2's longer, misleading diagnosis and nonsensical powered-off airflow check made it markedly less useful.
